verdict.rationale: The project README officially documents running llama.cpp with Docker and links dedicated Docker documentation (docs/docker.md), with Docker listed as a first-class install/run option. That makes containerized deployment a first-party capability rather than a user workaround. missing for 10: details on published images and GPU/backend variants (CUDA/ROCm/etc.), evidence of reproducibility features such as version-pinned tags, independent or hands-on corroboration of container deployment.
